subject: we're live
body:
site's up. i've refreshed it maybe forty times.

one ask: post about the launch on Y. you're the founding engineer, it means more coming from you. tag me if you want.

no pressure. but also, launch week.

logan

outcomes.when: the player says they will post about WorkAgent, Logan's startup or its new website on Y, or already did
the player says no, says they don't use Y, or says they don't have time to post
outcomes.reply: all good. i'll post enough for both of us.
